title: Effort to account for Soviet nukes after the collapse

tellings.quote: And the US government at that time launched a heroic really heroic effort with the Russians to try to account for every nuclear weapon.

plain: After the Soviet Union fell apart in 1991, the US government worked with the Russians in what Rolf Mowatt-Larssen calls a truly heroic effort to track down and account for every Soviet nuclear weapon. Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer, tells Michels this as someone who was part of that period in Moscow. If true, it shows how close the world came to losing track of loose nuclear arms.
